title: Compile one canonical world into an inhabitable Screen Deck
objective: Create the first substrate-independent Holodeck atom: validate one canonical world model, compile it deterministically into a renderer-neutral deck plan, let human and machine actors use the same bounded intent contract, expose structured sensory frames, preserve explicit local state snapshots, and render a small interactive world through a screen adapter.
successConditions: the same canonical world produces the same normalized deck plan and semantic digest
a human keyboard or touch input and a machine request enter through the same intent dispatcher
an interaction changes bounded world state and is visible in the next sensory frame
an explicit snapshot restores equivalent state in a fresh controller
the screen deck remains a replaceable adapter rather than the owner of world meaning

requirements.title: Compile canonical meaning into a stable deck plan
Dispatch identical bounded intents for human and machine actors
Expose world state as a compact machine-readable sensory frame
Snapshot and restore explicit local deck state
Render and inhabit the deck through a screen adapter
Provide one complete interactive example world
